concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-mirakl-test-and-go-live]] — 2026-09-15 Mirakl connector test-to-live checklist for seller sync/KYC, split-pay-in and modification tests, invoice/payout checks, Adyen-configured live settings and pilot sellers; real bank payouts require live verification.
warnings: Test environment cannot test real payouts; Mirakl invoice Paid label is not independent bank-receipt proof.
The connector manages seller-payment blocking and unsuspends new KYC-verified shops by default unless the operator asks Adyen to disable either feature; confirm desired seller controls.
Checklist does not grant live approval, define MOR or establish successful payment/settlement outcomes.
